items.why: Crude jumped as futures fell on reviving inflation worries, the day's dominant macro story. India's Sensex sank to a 32-month low on the same oil surge.
The fear gauge ticked up as S&P, Dow and Nasdaq futures fell on the oil spike and rising Treasury yields, a classic risk-off move.
EU regulators pushed the Full Self-Driving approval vote to December, denting a key revenue catalyst, with the risk-off tape adding pressure.
Chip stocks slid early Thursday even after TSMC posted record September revenue, as rising oil prices and Treasury yields kept investors in risk-off mode.

market_note: S&P, Dow and Nasdaq futures all down; crude is the day's risk driver.
summary: Futures are red across the board Thursday morning, with surging oil reviving inflation worries and pushing yields higher. Growth and AI names are selling off even after TSMC posted record revenue.
